rows.en: Ken! Stay calm!

My brother died back then…

No, that's certainly what I thought. Brother…
Brotheeer!!

You are Ken Kurenai, aren't you?

Dr. Kenichiro Kurenai would like to speak with you, just the two of you.
My brother does?
Now, this way…
Ken…?
Brother?
Brother!? You're all right!
Yeah…
What's wrong, Brother? Are you sick? They're still controlling you, aren't they?
Ken… Won't you hand Red Baron over to me?
What are you saying?
Without Red Baron… they're finally going to execute me! Please… save your brother!
Brother…
Once I'm free, I'll build you a robot even better than Red Baron.

No!!

If I hand over Red Baron, it's all over!! They'll kill you too, Brother.
That's not true!!
You can only say that because they're controlling you, Brother!

It seems the negotiations have broken down? Talking any further is a waste of time…

Well then… farewell, Ken Kurenai.

Wait!

Who on earth are you? Where are you taking my brother?
We are humble merchants who call ourselves the battle-fleet nation Naager.

…!?

So it's you? The ones backing evil organizations and peddling weapons?

We don't care to stand in the limelight… but it seems we're becoming quite a well-known organization?

Heh heh heh… This is getting interesting. Allow us to show you our flagship product! Until we meet again…
Mari! And [HERO2], [HERO4]!
We heard the story from Mari. Isn't it wonderful? Your brother being alive…
Looks like this is no time for a leisurely chat! Look, it's Gigant!
That robot is…?
Mari! And [HERO2], [HERO4]!
We heard the story from Mari. Isn't that great? Your brother being alive…
This is no time for a leisurely chat! Look, it's Gigant!
Hiryu! It's the Hiryu that Japan built!

Hiryu…

All right, come on! I'll smash you! Red Barooon!!
Red Baron is invincible!
Heh heh heh… I wonder about that? Ken Kurenai!
D-Dr. Deviler!?
Look closely! Look closely at Hiryu's cockpit!

…!?

B-Brother!?

How about that, Ken Kurenai! Your invincible Red Baron can't lay a finger on it, can it?

If it galls you, why not attack? A single missile would blow your brother to pieces! Ha ha ha…

Damn you, Deviler! My brother is being controlled! I can't attack him like that!

What am I supposed to do? My brother turned out to be alive, and we have to meet again like this! Brother…
Waaaagh…
Ken… Why? Why would you do this to me…
Brotheeeer!!
Brother!! Please stop! Brother!!

Ken, listen carefully!!

The one you believe is your brother is an Iron Mask Party android! We found out by hitting Hiryu with radiation! It was a trap to defeat Red Baron!
Then my brother is…?
Damn you, using my brother's face…! Fight Lever, on!
Deviler!! Your schemes won't work on me!

Heh heh heh… Seeing through Android X is no reason to relax yet!!

You and Red Baron have only moments left!!
Now, let's see you withstand 100,000 degrees of heat!
Keeen!! Get out of there, quick!!
It's no good!! I can't get out!!
Ken!! Get out somehow! Keeen!
Heh heh heh… How do you like the taste of a scorching hell? Ha ha ha ha…
Run!! Get out of there!!
Ken…
Damn… Curse you, Deviler!
Grr… Hiryu has melted!?
Oh well… The same goes for Red Baron. Heh heh heh… Ha ha ha ha!
Red Baron's burnt black…
Ken, if you're alive, answer me!!
It's no use, Boss… It was hot enough to melt Hiryu.
Ken, answer me!! Keeen!!
Look!! Red Baron is moving!
Ah…
Unbelievable…
Rising again from the flames… You're a true phoenix, Ken!!
Didn't I tell you? Red Baron is invincible!
Curse you… Red Baron!

It seems the Iron Mask Party is no longer up to the task…

The TDF will have already arranged to mass-produce the super alloy Baronium. Along with developing New Baronium…

Iron Mask Party robots like Hiryu won't stand a chance from now on.
Then… what do you suggest I do?

Who knows?

We spare no effort in helping those who are capable…

You…

I listened quietly, and you have the gall… Are you calling the Iron Mask Party incompetent?

If that isn't so…

then what should you do? You should already have the answer…
Grr… Enough! I don't need your help!
As you wish…
It seems the experiment was a great success…
Yes… Thanks to you, Doctor.
Boss…? What experiment?

uncertain: U08585-U08623: 兄さん rendered "Brother" as a form of address.
U08604/U08608: [HERO4]'s 聞きました — subject taken as "We".
U08610-U08649: 飛鷭 read as 飛龍 (glossary Hiryu; the stage condition U08704 names the robot 飛龍). 日本が作った飛龍 refers to the WWII aircraft name.
U08618/U08621: the fake brother (Android X) still referred to as "your brother"/"him" by the characters until U08624.
U08629: 10万度 rendered "100,000 degrees" (no unit given).
U08637/U08638: narration-kind row continues Deviler's line.
